blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Three motorcycle riders died in separate road accidents in Quezon province on Saturday, Nov. 7, police said. In Calauag town, a 19-year-old male motorcycle rider and his 17-year-old back rider were traveling along a road in Barangay Sta. Maria when the driver suddenly lost control of the vehicle, according to a police report. The motorcycle went out of control, throwing the two riders onto the pavement. It then struck two boys, aged 8 and 11, before sliding underneath a parked truck on the roadside. READ: 2 motorcycle riders killed, 2 injured in Quezon road crashes The two riders […]...
